scope: Fresh source/procedure cross-check after blind findings freeze; no dashboards, SQL execution, email, merges, payments or deployment actions.

checks.detail: Ordered0001–0008 selected separately; successful SQL/RLS checks explicitly precede the GitHub merge/deploy trigger.
Read-only before audit, review irrecoverable/mismatched data, then private backup/repair transaction, after audit and actual changed-row/rerun evidence.
Production and Preview public refs match documented identifiers; Preview browser/server addresses pinned only on hosted Vercel Preview. This does not verify dashboard secrets or live project state.

NEUTRAL_TEAM_NAMING, STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK, VITE_POSTHOG_KEY/HOST, LOOP_FOUNDATION_ENABLED, ROOM_EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED and SMTP_VERIFIED are actual source names. Payment URL is validated and omitted if unset; notification verification flag alone supplies no sender.
Hosted origin must be public HTTPS; origin derives from explicit PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN or Vercel system URL. Local canonical values are verification-only.
Source callback path is /auth/callback. Email-token UI is used; no browser password/reset UI is declared. Real SMTP/provider redemption remains pending.
Owner checks distinguish physical mobile/sharing, real two-account provider ownership, receipt and analytics/payment sink confirmation from synthetic local QA.
Vercel rollback restores application deployment, not SQL/provider/data. Kill switch is documented for Loop-only containment.

recommendedClarifications.recommendation: Include /clash/one-franchise, /clash/one-per-era and /clash/no-mvps explicitly, or state that /clash/filters smoke must open all three variants.
Reconcile its specific performance/calibration blocker wording only against final current evidence; do not copy prior status into fresh acceptance.

Payments/provider ingestion, rights/license clearance, operator/contact/retention decisions and physical-device behavior.
